_comment: Example MCP server config for an AI-assisted QA workflow. Copy the relevant block into your Claude Code / Cursor MCP settings. Replace ALL <...> placeholders. NEVER commit real tokens — use environment variables.

playwright._use: Let the assistant drive a real browser to explore the app and capture stable locators while writing tests.

postgres-testdata._use: Read-only DB access so the assistant can generate SQL data-validation checks and provision deterministic test data. Point at a TEST database only.

github._use: Read PRs/issues and CI run logs so the assistant can write regression tests from bug reports and debug failing CI runs.

filesystem._use: Scoped file access to your test directory so the assistant can read existing page objects before generating new tests.
